name: kube-pane
description: A kubectl context chip above the prompt and a Dracula-themed pods pane: switch context for Claude's session without touching your kubeconfig, filter pods, and open a shell in any container from the app's Terminal.

productionPattern.title: Production context pattern
productionPattern.description: Regular expression that marks a context as production (case-insensitive): red chip and a confirmation before opening a shell.

defaultNamespace.title: Default namespace
defaultNamespace.description: Namespace the pane opens on when the cluster has it.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the open pane reloads the pods.

pageSize.title: Pods per page
pageSize.description: Rows per page in the pods table.

kubectlPath.title: kubectl path
kubectlPath.description: Full path to kubectl when it is not on the PATH Claude Code sees.
